name: ABS
notes: FP32, int8 and quantized int16 run CORE; quantized scaling requirements apply. Unquantized int16 uses Reference, which wraps -32768. FP16 requires ARM_NN_ENABLE_F16; without it preparation fails.

name: ADD
notes: Float identical-shape inputs support arbitrary rank. Optimized broadcasting supports rank <= 4; higher-rank FP32 uses Reference and FP16 is rejected. int32 follows the adapter reference path.

name: ARG_MAX
notes: int8 runs CORE, FP32 runs CORE with ARM_NN_ENABLE_F32 and FP16 with ARM_NN_ENABLE_F16, at rank 1..4 with INT32 axis/output and positive reduced extent; other configurations use Reference (FP16 is rejected). A NaN never wins and ties keep the first index.

name: ARG_MIN
notes: int8 runs CORE, FP32 runs CORE with ARM_NN_ENABLE_F32 and FP16 with ARM_NN_ENABLE_F16, at rank 1..4 with INT32 axis/output and positive reduced extent; other configurations use Reference (FP16 is rejected). A NaN never wins and ties keep the first index.

name: AVERAGE_POOL_2D
notes: Four-dimensional tensors; check filter/stride/padding and output dimensions. Kernel failure is returned to the application.

name: BATCH_MATMUL
notes: Check batch broadcasting, adjoint flags and quantized weight/activation combinations against the adapter.

name: CONCATENATION
notes: Optimized float paths support rank <= 4; higher-rank float inputs use Reference. Input/output type and quantization must agree.

name: CONV_2D
notes: Quantized weight/bias combinations are constrained. int4 weights use int8 activations. Float grouped convolution uses Reference for FP32 and is rejected for FP16.

name: COS
notes: Reference implementation in the HELIA adapter source; Float32 input/output.

name: DEPTHWISE_CONV_2D
notes: Quantized weight/bias combinations and depth multiplier are constrained. int4 is a weight type with int8 activations; it is not a general activation type.

name: DEQUANTIZE
notes: Output is FP32. FP16 means weight-storage widening, not FP16 computation; it works without ARM_NN_ENABLE_F16 and matches the reference widening bit for bit at reset FPSCR: a NaN keeps its sign and payload and comes back quiet. On cores with an FPU but no MVE float16 (for example cortex-m4+fp) the widening runs on the FPU, so with FPSCR.DN (default NaN) set every NaN becomes 0x7FC00000.

name: EQUAL
notes: Boolean output. Supported input types depend on the comparison; input shapes and broadcast rules must match.

name: FILL
notes: Constant dimensions and scalar fill value. Float APIs require CORE >= 7.33.0 and matching enabled feature.

name: FULLY_CONNECTED
notes: Quantized activation/weight/bias types must match a supported combination; includes int4 weights with int8 activations. Float paths require matching CORE features.

name: GATHER
notes: CORE >= 7.34.0. Native rank <= 4. Scalar indices use float native paths or int8 Reference; int16 rejects them. Higher-rank FP32/int8 use Reference; FP16/int16 reject.

name: GATHER_ND
notes: CORE >= 7.34.0. Native ranks <= 4 and positive index tuple width. Higher ranks and zero-width tuples use FP32/int8 Reference; FP16/int16 reject.

name: GREATER
notes: Boolean output. Check broadcast and operand types; no FP16 comparison branch.

name: GREATER_EQUAL
notes: Boolean output. Check broadcast and operand types; no FP16 comparison branch.

name: HARD_SWISH
notes: FP16 requires the CORE float feature; without it preparation fails. FP32 can use Reference.

name: LEAKY_RELU
notes: Float32 uses the reference path. No FP16 execution branch in this adapter.

name: LESS
notes: Boolean output. Check broadcast and operand types; no FP16 comparison branch.

name: LESS_EQUAL
notes: Boolean output. Check broadcast and operand types; no FP16 comparison branch.

name: LOG
notes: Reference implementation in the HELIA adapter source; Float32 input/output.

name: LOGICAL_NOT
notes: Reference boolean operation.

name: LOGISTIC
notes: int8 uses a lookup table; int16 and enabled floats have HELIA paths. NaN is not supported by the optimized float activation path.

name: MAXIMUM
notes: Optimized paths support rank <= 4. Higher-rank FP32/int8/int16 use Reference; FP16 is rejected. int32/int64 use Reference.

name: MAX_POOL_2D
notes: Four-dimensional tensors; check filter/stride/padding and output dimensions. Kernel failure is returned to the application.

name: MEAN
notes: Float optimized paths support rank <= 4 and axis sets; higher-rank FP32 uses Reference, FP16 is rejected. See reduce_common.cc.

name: MINIMUM
notes: Optimized paths support rank <= 4. Higher-rank FP32/int8/int16 use Reference; FP16 is rejected. int32/int64 use Reference.

name: MUL
notes: Float identical-shape inputs support arbitrary rank. Optimized broadcasting supports rank <= 4; higher-rank FP32 uses Reference and FP16 is rejected. int32 follows the adapter reference path.

name: NEG
notes: FP32 and FP16 run CORE as sign-bit flips, NaN payloads kept. FP16 requires ARM_NN_ENABLE_F16; without it preparation fails.

name: NOT_EQUAL
notes: Boolean output. Supported input types depend on the comparison; input shapes and broadcast rules must match.

name: PACK
notes: Equal input shapes, including scalars. Float APIs require CORE >= 7.33.0 and matching enabled feature.

name: PAD
notes: FP16 requires four-dimensional tensors and the float feature. Padding values and output shape must match.

name: PADV2
notes: FP16 requires four-dimensional tensors and the float feature. Padding values and output shape must match.

name: QUANTIZE
notes: Supported input/output pairs are specific: this type list does not imply all pairings. Registration is supplied by kernels/quantize.cc.

name: REDUCE_ALL
notes: Boolean reduction using Reference in reduce_common.cc.

name: REDUCE_MAX
notes: int8/int16 run CORE at rank <= 4 with equal input/output quantization. FP32 uses Reference to keep TFLite's non-finite results (NaN skipped, -FLT_MAX for an all -Inf or empty window). FP16 runs CORE at rank <= 4 and is rejected otherwise or without ARM_NN_ENABLE_F16; unlike FP32 it propagates NaN (canonical 0x7e00) and gives -Inf for an all -Inf or empty window. An output tensor whose size differs from the reduction fails the op. Implementation is in reduce_common.cc.

name: REDUCE_MIN
notes: int8/int16 run CORE at rank <= 4 with equal input/output quantization. FP32 uses Reference to keep TFLite's non-finite results (NaN skipped, +FLT_MAX for an all +Inf or empty window). FP16 runs CORE at rank <= 4 and is rejected otherwise or without ARM_NN_ENABLE_F16; unlike FP32 it propagates NaN (canonical 0x7e00) and gives +Inf for an all +Inf or empty window. An output tensor whose size differs from the reduction fails the op. Implementation is in reduce_common.cc.

name: RELU
notes: Check activation bounds, tensor shape and quantization. Optimized float paths require the matching CORE feature.

name: RELU6
notes: Check activation bounds, tensor shape and quantization. Optimized float paths require the matching CORE feature.

name: RESHAPE
notes: Preserves storage and element count. FP16 storage works without float arithmetic enabled. Types listed here are representative fixed-width storage types.

name: RSQRT
notes: FP32 and FP16 run CORE; integer paths use Reference. FP16 requires CORE >= 7.33.0 and ARM_NN_ENABLE_F16; input/output shapes and types must match. A negative input gives the positive quiet NaN.

name: SIN
notes: Reference implementation in the HELIA adapter source; Float32 input/output.

name: SOFTMAX
notes: Optimized float path requires beta = 1. Other beta values use FP32 Reference or fail FP16 preparation. int8-to-int16 output has a dedicated registration.

name: SPLIT
notes: Constant axis and equal output extents. Float APIs require CORE >= 7.33.0 and corresponding enabled feature.

name: SPLIT_V
notes: Constant axis and split sizes; one inferred -1 size and zero-length pieces are allowed. Shapes/types/counts are checked during preparation. Float APIs require CORE >= 7.33.0.

name: SQRT
notes: FP32 and FP16 run CORE. FP16 requires CORE >= 7.33.0 and ARM_NN_ENABLE_F16; input/output shapes and types must match. A negative input gives the positive quiet NaN.

name: SQUARE
notes: Reference implementation in the HELIA adapter source; Float32 input/output.

name: SQUEEZE
notes: Bitwise storage copy; removes unit dimensions, checks matching byte counts and rejects strings. Input rank <= 8.

name: STRIDED_SLICE
notes: int8, int16 and int32 run CORE; FP32 runs CORE with ARM_NN_ENABLE_F32 and Reference without it; FP16 runs CORE with ARM_NN_ENABLE_F16 and fails preparation without it; bool uses Reference. Rank is limited to 4; an empty slice writes nothing, and an output tensor smaller than the slice fails the op.

name: SUB
notes: Float identical-shape inputs support arbitrary rank. Optimized broadcasting supports rank <= 4; higher-rank FP32 uses Reference and FP16 is rejected. int32 follows the adapter reference path.

name: SUM
notes: SUM is LiteRT REDUCE_SUM. Float optimized paths support rank <= 4 and axis sets; higher-rank FP32 uses Reference, FP16 is rejected. See reduce_common.cc.

name: SVDF
notes: Data input is int8, FP32 or enabled FP16. int16 is a time-weight/state type, not a supported data input type. Variable state persists across invocations; weight types, rank and activation configuration are constrained.

name: TANH
notes: NaN is not supported by the optimized float activation path. Float support is build-gated.

name: TRANSPOSE
notes: Optimized rank <= 4. Higher ranks use Reference; FP16 has a bitwise storage fallback even with its float feature disabled.

name: TRANSPOSE_CONV
notes: Check output shape, padding and quantized weight/bias combinations. Float features are build-gated.

name: UNIDIRECTIONAL_SEQUENCE_LSTM
notes: Standard four-gate LSTM only. Preparation rejects peephole, projection, layer normalization and missing gates (CIFG), including FP32. Quantized inputs use int8 weights and int16 cell state. Preserve variable state across invocations.

name: UNPACK
notes: One output per selected axis element. Float APIs require CORE >= 7.33.0 and matching enabled feature.

name: ZEROS_LIKE
notes: Fills output storage with zero; no FP16 execution branch.
